messages:
maria: Heads-up: p99 on the Latency Console climbed ~350ms at 11:12 UTC after we flipped adaptive-routing's quota fallback. p50/p95 unchanged. Dashboard shows an endpoint variant spiking. Anyone know if routing added a fallback tier that changes client tagging?
aj: I saw the alert. Quick question: is this only on eu region or global?
maria: Only eu for now, link: https://console.redwood/latency?slice=eu&range=15m :point_up: 
samir: From logs, a bunch of requests spilled to model-quantized-v2 (fallback) around 11:11:48. Those endpoints have slower cold kv-cache behavior -> longer tails.
eli: Can we confirm sample origin? dashboard p99 is computed from merged rollups. If sampling switched to bridge-route weights, p99 can pop without an actual endpoint regression.
maria: Good point. I pulled the query: `sum by(endpoint,origin) (count_over_time(requests[5m]))` — shows origin switched to 'fallback' for that route.
zoe: @samir can you paste the exact log lines or grep? Also is quota routing policy set to `fallthrough: true` or a hard stop?
samir: grep output: `2026-03-20T11:11:47Z route=playground fallback=model-quantized-v2 reason=quota_exceeded` — policy had `allow_burst: true, fallthrough: true`
aj: So quota_exceeded caused heavier routing to slower variant. console rollup merged origins and didn't annotate which pctl sources were from fallback. UX bug: no provenance badge when merge comes from fallback-only samples.
eli: We should add a provenance legend + per-origin pctl breakdown. Short-term: add an annotation on the time window saying 'fallback routing increased' so on-call knows cause.
maria: Agree. Also propose: adjust sampling before merge to tag pctl with origin and include sample counts. We can hotfix the dashboard query to show p95/p99 by origin.
samir: Quick mitigation: revert adaptive-routing fallback weight to 0.5 and enable kv-cache warmup for quantized pool.
zoe: I can roll a dashboard patch: add `group by origin` to the pctl query and a small banner. ETA 30m.
deploy-bot: Canary: changed adaptive-routing.fallback.weight from 1 -> 0.5 in eu (canary) at 11:28 UTC by zoe
aj: Thanks. Postmortem note: telemetry needs clearer contract: pctl provenance required for rollups involving different model pools.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll open a short RFC and assign owners.
